release: TASK-015 Slice 4b — engagement safety: conversation closure, close_engagement, viewing protection, non-destructive photo restriction
rollback_note: SAFETY BARRIER. No schema change (CONVERSATION and MEDIA decisions, close_engagement and RESTRICTED exist since Slice 1), but rollback to Slice 4a is BLOCKED: that build confirms viewings on a listing under a moderation hold, lets a requester whose conversation Homies closed open a new one on the same publication (G-14), and checks a conversation's status without locking it, so a message can land after a closure. The Slice 4a privacy barrier still stands behind it. Recovery is forward repair only.
